svg.title: The with statement

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with: guaranteed cleanup, even on exceptions

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A context manager's __enter__ runs on the way in and __exit__ always runs on the way out.

svg.text: If the body raises, __exit__ STILL runs

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The exception is passed to __exit__. Returning True from __exit__ SWALLOWS it; returning False (the

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: normal choice) re-raises it after cleanup. open()'s __exit__ calls f.close() and returns False.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Manual try/finally gets this wrong constantly - the with statement makes it structurally impossible.
